query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Using a ceramic material, specifically silicon carbide (SiC), for preparing parts for the dipping and plating equipment can protect the equipment from erosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum.
generation.material_initial_state: High-purity (>99%) solid silicon carbide (SiC) ceramic material with a fine grain size (<10 μm) and a smooth surface finish (<1 μm roughness)
generation.intervention: Immersion in high-temperature liquid aluminum at 700°C for 100 hours
generation.conditions: High-temperature conditions, in contact with liquid aluminum
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a protective alumina (Al2O3) layer on the SiC surface, which occurs spontaneously at temperatures above 600°C in the presence of liquid aluminum
generation.mechanism: The SiC material reacts with the liquid aluminum to form a thin, dense alumina layer, which acts as a barrier to prevent further corrosion. The temperature range of 600-800°C and the use of pure aluminum liquid composition facilitate the formation of this protective layer, enhancing the corrosion resistance of the SiC material
generation.predicted_outcome: A reduction in corrosion rate from 10 mm/year to 1 mm/year, which is at least 90% compared to currently used materials
generation.baseline: Currently used materials for equipment components, which exhibit a corrosion rate of 10 mm/year under the same conditions
generation.boundary: Temperature range: 600-800°C, aluminum liquid composition: pure Al. These conditions are critical for the formation of the protective alumina layer and the resulting corrosion resistance
generation.uncertainty: The actual corrosion rate of the SiC material may vary depending on factors such as the specific composition of the aluminum liquid, the surface finish of the SiC material, and the presence of any impurities or defects

falsification_experiment.design: Immersion test of SiC samples in high-temperature liquid aluminum
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the corrosion rate of SiC is not reduced by at least 80% compared to the control group's corrosion rate of 10 mm/year, the hypothesis is falsified
